subject: *: make package `sqlexec` not depend on `sessionctx` anymore (#52031)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent focusing on executor/planner/privilege/session/sessionctx/statistics (and the `sqlexec` refactor they depend on). The change is a dependency refactor: `pkg/util/sqlexec` drops direct `sessionctx.Context` usage (new `pkg/sessionctx/sysproctrack`, trimmed `sqlexec.SQLExecutor`, `ExecSQL` now takes `sqlexec.SQLExecutor`), while `sessionctx.Context` and `planner/context.PlanContext` add `GetSQLExecutor`/`GetRestrictedSQLExecutor` and call sites switch from type assertions to these getters. `pkg/session/session.go` implements both getters by returning the session itself, so the internal SQL execution/txn/privilege/statistics paths remain behaviorally equivalent. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, privilege behavior, or session/transaction handling in the touched areas.
